name: Pirate Utopia
source:
Fifty years have passed since the Terrestrial Coalition's victory against the Sikhis, an alien species native to the planet Urvashi-32b. Since then, the Terrestrial Coalition has imposed its free-market democracy on the new planet.

You are a Sikhi returning from Earth after three years of working at the New York Times and failing to carve a niche for yourself, and now you are set to arrive back on your home planet with a strong sense of defeat. 

But something is about to unfold that may provide you with the breakout scoop of your professional career.

[translated from [url=https://unapersona-y-otrapersona.itch.io/pirate-utopia]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
地球联邦击败乌尔婆尸-32b星球原生外星种族锡希族，已经过去了50年。从那以后，地球联邦便将自由市场民主制度强加于这颗新星球。

你是一名锡希族人，在地球上的《纽约时报》工作了三年，却始终未能闯出自己的一片天地。如今，你带着深深的挫败感，即将回到故乡星球。

然而，一件即将发生的事，或许会为你带来职业生涯中一举成名的独家报道。

[译自[url=https://unapersona-y-otrapersona.itch.io/pirate-utopia]itch.io[/url]]
